recent_actions.Action: Sudan's army built a 51 km defense network around El Obeid amid RSF encirclement; drone strikes on infrastructure caused a severe humanitarian crisis.
recent_actions.Title: Sudan's army has built a 51 km network of trenches and berms to defend the strategic city of El Obeid from an ongoing RSF encirclement, according to satellite analysis from Yale HRL. Meanwhile, targeted drone strikes on fuel and electrical infrastructure have cut off power to vital water pumps, triggering a severe humanitarian crisis. The cost of drinking water has spiked from 9,000 to 25,000 Sudanese pounds per barrel, as over 700 new displacement structures appear in a single month.
